hooks.command: jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty" | { read -r f; case "$f" in */docker/.env|docker/.env) printf "%s" "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"Reading and writing docker/.env is blocked by a project hook (it contains secrets).\"}}";; esac; }

c=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); if printf "%s" "$c" | grep -qE "docker/\.env([^.A-Za-z0-9_]|$)"; then printf "%s" "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"Accessing docker/.env via Bash is blocked by a project hook (it contains secrets).\"}}"; fi
